$comment: The `mcpCapabilities` blocks the two real agents ACTUALLY advertise, copied out of the
recorded corpora rather than recalled. `filterMcpCapabilities`'s tests read these so that a
future agent-version bump changes ONE file rather than a dozen literals.
The pair is the whole argument of §23.2: codex says `sse:false` and `acp:false` while taking
stdio servers without complaint, which is why stdio is never filtered and why a filter keyed
on an absent bit would drop every stdio preset from the agent that uses them most.
